claims.claim: Readers can suggest corrections to public articles through a Web UI
claims.quote: Signed-in community members get 「建议修改」 below a public article

claims.claim: Proposals are rate-limited per reader
claims.quote: 5 a minute and 30 a day

claims.claim: Only one open proposal per reader-article pair
claims.quote: one open proposal per reader and article

claims.claim: Proposals include SHA-256 of the body being edited
claims.quote: the proposal carries a SHA-256 of the body they started from

claims.claim: Reviewers see proposals in a studio section with line diffs
claims.quote: A new 「读者勘误」 studio section lists open proposals with a line diff

claims.claim: Acceptance preserves all bytes before the body including BOM and CRLF
claims.quote: Every byte before the body is kept, including a BOM and CRLF frontmatter

claims.claim: Proposals become STALE if body no longer matches base at acceptance time
claims.quote: Otherwise the proposal becomes STALE

claims.claim: Accepted proposers are credited in article footer unless blocked
claims.quote: Accepted proposers are thanked in the article footer, unless they and an owner have blocked each other

claims.claim: Acceptance was initially two-step with no mutual exclusion
claims.quote: Acceptance wrote Git first and then resolved the proposal with an update from OPEN whose miss was ignored

claims.claim: Acceptance now uses ACCEPTING status with ten-minute claim timeout
claims.quote: a claim stranded for ten minutes can be retaken

claims.claim: Cancelled credit-naming does not write Poketto-Suggested-By trailer
claims.quote: A proposer who declines naming is also left out of the commit trailer

claims.claim: Failed resolve in same transaction rolls back entire acceptance
claims.quote: 失败就整条回滚（notification failure in transaction rolls back)

claims.claim: Cleanup of old resolved proposals has no index on resolved_at
claims.quote: resolved_at 上没有索引

claims.claim: Cleanup query scans full table on each new proposal
claims.quote: 所以这条更新得扫全表

claims.claim: Credit lookup uses workspace, route, and (optionally) article id
claims.quote: Credit is keyed by the article a proposal was made for, its frontmatter id or else its creation time

claims.claim: Old route-only credit persists for proposals stored before id columns existed
claims.quote: Proposals stored before the columns existed keep route-only credit instead of losing it

claims.claim: Mine query failure no longer hides entire correction UI
claims.quote: mine 失败只隐藏状态，不再让入口消失

claims.claim: Stranded ACCEPTING claims now appear as OPEN to proposers after ten minutes
claims.quote: A claim whose acceptance never settled was only retakeable through a second acceptance, yet... now counts as open

claims.claim: Reviewers can re-accept a stranded ACCEPTING proposal after ten minutes
claims.quote: 审稿人可以不采纳，也可以重新采纳

claims.claim: Already-applied acceptance no longer reports false success
claims.quote: An acceptance that finds the body already applied records the commit it read and tells the reviewer no new commit was made

analysis_rows.symptom: Race condition: Git write succeeds but state update fails
analysis_rows.cause: Acceptance updates state in separate transaction after Git write, miss treated as success
analysis_rows.evidence: changed == 0 silently treated as success in resolve method; no retry or rollback
analysis_rows.fix: Reserve ACCEPTING status before Git write, settle only own claim; treat missed update as conflict

analysis_rows.symptom: Mine query failure hides entire correction UI
analysis_rows.cause: Try block wraps both initialization queries; catch sets entire state to null
analysis_rows.evidence: correction-proposal.tsx useEffect; if (!state) return null; 204 response not handled
analysis_rows.fix: Separate try blocks per query; mine failure returns undefined without hiding component

analysis_rows.symptom: Readers unknowingly credited with permanent public attribution
analysis_rows.cause: Credits public API not mentioned in submission UI; no opt-out for accepted proposals
analysis_rows.evidence: /api/public/community/spaces/{space}/corrections/credits endpoint; submit dialog silent on naming
analysis_rows.fix: Add checkbox mentioning footer attribution and commit trailer; default checked

analysis_rows.symptom: ACCEPTING proposal permanently stuck when process crashes or write fails
analysis_rows.cause: Review list filters status='OPEN' only; ACCEPTING invisible; only retakeable via second accept needing id
analysis_rows.evidence: CommunityCorrections.java line 161; no listing of ACCEPTING; proposer withdraw button hidden
analysis_rows.fix: After 10 minutes, treat ACCEPTING as OPEN for listing, withdrawal, and re-acceptance

analysis_rows.symptom: Full-table scan on each proposal when cleaning 90-day-old text
analysis_rows.cause: resolved_at column lacks database index; cleanup query in proposer transaction with locks held
analysis_rows.evidence: V22 created 3 indexes, resolved_at excluded; update runs during propose with account+publish locks
analysis_rows.fix: Add partial index on resolved_at for resolved rows; move cleanup to scheduled task

analysis_rows.symptom: Credit attached to wrong article when route reused or articles swap URLs
analysis_rows.cause: Credits query keys only on (workspace, route); ignores current article identity
analysis_rows.evidence: CommunityCorrections.credits line 149; no article-id check; PublicDocument footer renders same list
analysis_rows.fix: Store and match both article frontmatter-id and creation-time; different article at same route loses old credit

analysis_rows.symptom: Reader chooses no-credit but commit trailer written anyway
analysis_rows.cause: credited field only affects footer insert and credits query, not WritePrincipal creation
analysis_rows.evidence: CommunityCorrections line 207 WritePrincipal created unconditionally; credited=false ignored
analysis_rows.fix: Omit WritePrincipal when credited=false; update checkbox label to mention both footer and commit trailer

analysis_rows.symptom: Acceptance reports success but can't name commit when body already matched
analysis_rows.cause: ALREADY_APPLIED branch returns null commit; resolve still marks ACCEPTED without commit identity
analysis_rows.evidence: RepositoryReviewedBodyEdits line 71; replaceBody returns ALREADY_APPLIED with no commit
analysis_rows.fix: Read and store current commit hash on ALREADY_APPLIED; report in acceptance response

analysis_rows.value: High: Git write succeeds, state update fails silently
Low: only own claim can close; missed update returns conflict
O(n) full-table scan on each proposal, held during proposer transaction
O(log n) after 90-day filter; can move to scheduled task
Incorrect: new article at old route inherits old credits
Correct: each article gets its own credits; different id treated as new article

analysis_rows.positioning: Central orchestrator for propose, accept, decline, withdraw; handles gating, notifications, rate limits

analysis_rows.positioning: Handles actual file modification; detects ALREADY_APPLIED; preserves bytes before body

analysis_rows.positioning: Renders proposal submission UI; shows status; hides withdraw button during ACCEPTING
analysis_rows.key_facts: Uses .catch(() => undefined) to isolate mine query failure; shows credit checkbox; reads mine proposals on mount
